snippet.title: Frostpoint Toll - Teaser
snippet.description:
Suddenly I am making video games. And this is my small announcement 😺

If you want to support my work, the best way will be to wishlist this game - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3507600/Frostpoint_Toll/

Flavor Text - "A machine of war, repurposed for labor. Frostpoint Toll is a meditative action roguelike where you mine, collect, and forgive—because here, moving forward means learning to let go."

Have a nice day and stay 🐾sitive
